note: Real mission/landing sites, rough context positions for orientation only - NOT geodetic precision, NOT routing targets. Coordinates as stated in the cited sources (frames vary). This catalog is not all-sites-verified. Catalog rev2 contract: site_type drives symbols; region is a hint only; ingenuity-final omitted (unverified).

sites.name: Perseverance (Mars 2020) - Octavia E. Butler Landing
sites.source_quote: NASA NTRS (EDL assessment paper): 'landed inside Jezero Crater at 18.44463 deg North latitude and 77.45088 deg East longitude'

sites.name: Zhurong (Tianwen-1)
sites.source_quote: Li et al. 2021, Nature Astronomy: 'the Zhurong rover landed at 109.925 E, 25.066 N at an elevation of -4,099.4 m'

sites.name: Mars 2 (failed descent)
sites.source_quote: NASA GISS: 'failed during descent on Nov. 27, 1971, and impacted at about 47 E -45 N in Hellas Planitia'

sites.name: Mars 3
sites.source_quote: NASA GISS: 'landed Dec. 2, 1971, at about 202 E -45 N in Ptolemaeus Crater in Terra Sirenum ... made soft landing and began transmitting a test image, but fell silent after about 20 s'

sites.name: Mars 6 (failed descent)
sites.source_quote: NASA GISS: 'failed during descent Mar. 12, 1974, and impacted at about 19.42 W -23.90 N near Samara Valles ... transmissions ceased in direct proximity to the surface'

sites.name: Mars Polar Lander + Deep Space 2 (estimated impact, aim point)
sites.source_quote: NASA GISS: 'likely crashed on descent Dec. 3, 1999, impacting at about 195.3 W -76.1 N in the Planum Australae. Failure was mostly likely caused by premature descent engine shutdown'

sites.name: Beagle 2
sites.source_quote: NASA GISS: 'landed Dec. 25, 2003, at 90.43 E, 11.53 N in Isidis Planitia ... orbital imagery had revealed the probe landed about 5 km from its target site and was apparently intact, but ... had not fully deployed' (coord source: Bridges et al. 2017)

sites.name: Schiaparelli EDM (impact)
sites.source_quote: NASA GISS: 'failed during descent on Oct. 19, 2016, and impacted at 353.79 E 2.07 S in Meridiani Planum ... about 5.5 km west of the planned landing point'
